Subject: Forecast sweep + account custody: prep for weekly submission & Friday rollcall

Team — quick heads up ahead of the weekly submission window. Goal: get Acme and our other late-stage lanes into good custody so the finance pack is accurate by EOD Thursday. High level asks: 

1) Stage hygiene: please confirm each close-prob and expected close date in the FY29 sheet (attached). If you change stage, add a short reason in the Notes column.

2) Evidence checklist: for any move to Commit, attach at least one of: signed SOW, PO confirmation, procurement email thread, or MAP (mutual action plan). If you have partial evidence, flag as "pending docs" with ETA.

3) Call agenda for Friday 10:00am PT rollcall (30m):
   - 5m: lane owner quick status (Rishi on Acme)
   - 10m: blockers & evidence gaps
   - 10m: risk mitigation / fallback motion (pricing/discount asks)
   - 5m: explicit owner handoffs and next steps

I've attached the FY29-forecast-template-v3.xlsx and a fillable MAP for Acme. Please update the sheet by Thursday 3pm PT so RevOps has time to validate before our rollcall.

If any account needs executive uplift or we expect a pricing exception, notify me + Laura by EOD Wednesday.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
(attachment: FY29-forecast-template-v3.xlsx)

Thanks Vivek — noted. Quick Acme status: 

- Current commit ask: $950k, target close 2028-07-31 (moved from 08/15 after exec call).
- Evidence: Signed terms (redlines cleared) are with procurement — awaiting PO (procurement@acme.com). I've dropped the mutual_action_plan into drive (Acme-MAP).
- Risk: procurement asked for a single-vendor indemnity clause; legal expects a 48h turnaround.

I'll update the FY29 sheet by Thursday noon with the probability change (moving to Commit) and add a short note: "PO pending - procurement ETA 7/5".

I'll be on the Friday 10:00am PT rollcall and will have the procurement thread ready.

-rishi

Adding a couple operational notes for the rollcall: 

- RevOps will do a quick evidence validation pass on Thursday 3:30pm PT. If your attachables aren't in Drive and linked in the sheet by then, we'll tag the row as "evidence missing" and it will not be eligible for Commit without a documented exec escalation.
- Please use the short-read format in column H for the reason when changing probability (one line). That helps finance audit trails.
- If you anticipate needing a temporary hold (e.g., legal review >5 business days), mark the row with the flag "hold-legal" and copy Laura.

Agenda tweak for Friday: allow 5 extra minutes for any procurement syncs (Rishi, make sure Sally or procurement rep can join).
